flags.reason: Paper says Isppa and Ispta dropped by approximately fivefold after a human skull but gives no in situ value; recorded as not_reported.
Paper calls the protocol tbTUS but describes it as 20 ms pulses every 200 ms for 80 s, i.e. a single-level 5 Hz train.
Free-water values come from a previous characterisation study of the transducer, quoted here.
Session order described as balanced across participants; randomisation not stated.
Vertex has no specific term; mapped to cerebral_cortex.
